# Reading interval

This paragraph separates the opening comments from the end of the example.
It gives the navigation checks room to distinguish preserving the current passage from jumping to the first review item.

A reader can change which records are shown while staying at the same place in the document.
The next and previous controls should then move relative to that place.

The example uses invented material throughout.
Its original and proposed readings are intentionally short enough to compare directly.

The final paragraph provides some space below the last anchored passage.
This lets the browser place that passage near the middle of the viewport during navigation checks.
